_note: A mood is searched as the average meaning of its phrases, written in Ronaldo's own voice, instead of the bare word. Add or edit freely; aliases are exact single-word queries that trigger the mood. Checked by reading the top 4 results of each: sad, motivated, love, grateful, proud, confident and ambitious are convincing; happy and tired are fair; nostalgic and calm are weak (few captions are about them). A 'humble' mood was removed because it returned noise.
